summary: Station-notice matching retains every notice on the scanned index pages, then opens only the detail-record cap.
reason: Reusing the notices command's 50-record output window drops later index rows before detail matching, so scanned page counts describe a broader check than the command performed. A regen must keep the full scanned index as the candidate list, apply the detail cap only to fetches, and say when later rows were not opened.
validated_outcome: A 55-notice index keeps ScannedRecords at 55, opens only the detail cap, and reports that later index rows were not fetched.
